mathematics.assertion_tested: Lean kernel-check of five exact real mixture/exponential lemmas: no-event lower bound, equality iff zero hit contribution for p0<1, host-difference identity, exp(-2)>21/200, and impossibility of the original spiral ceiling for n=2 and nonnegative hit contribution.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Lean real numbers and Mathlib's proved real exponential bounds; no floating-point premise
mathematics.conventions: retention(p0,hit)=p0+(1-p0)*hit. Lower bound assumes p0<=1 and hit>=0. Saturation equivalence assumes p0<1. Physical application additionally requires the common prescribed no-event/control flow, count/initial-data independence, homogeneous Poisson mean, measurable finite expectations, and strictly positive finite control normalization; these are not formalized in the Lean file.

bounds.lower_bound_domain: all real p0<=1 and real hit>=0
bounds.saturation_domain: all real p0<1 and real hit

non_claims: The Poisson measure law, expectation decomposition, independence, physical flow correspondence and integrability are not formalized here.
Does not establish a universal C003 no-go, action closure, empirical law, realistic halo simulation, or the literal lower bound for an independently sampled finite ratio.
An altered coupled force or an initial-condition/history-dependent rate may invalidate the model-to-algebra correspondence.
The exact no-event algebra does not require initial equilibrium and does not assert zero contribution from kicked particles.
